name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Toronto-based junior silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta province, northwestern Argentina. The company is in the exploration and development stage with an active multi-phase drill program targeting high-grade silver-gold mineralization at the Oculto and surrounding zones. It also holds the Aguas Perdidas project in Chubut Province and recently acquired the adjacent Condoryacu and Maria Amalia properties to expand the Diablillos land package.
